name: Backup Job Health
description: Portfolio-wide backup job health across whatever BCDR and SaaS-backup tools are connected: the two structurally different job models (image-based appliance backup vs. SaaS-data snapshot backup) and how to normalize them into one health record per protected unit, why a live consecutive-failure streak matters more than a trailing success rate, the missed-versus-failed distinction and its different root causes, and the two storage-trending risk patterns (approaching capacity, anomalous growth).
